name: aiquota-statusbar
description: Always-visible Claude usage in the status bar, measured by the aiquota CLI (same numbers as Claude Code's Account & usage view).

aiquota.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Full path of the `aiquota` binary (v0.6.0 or newer; `aiquota.exe` on Windows). Empty means the first one found in `~/.local/bin`, `$GOBIN`, `$GOPATH/bin`, `~/go/bin` (and `%LOCALAPPDATA%\\aiquota` on Windows). `go-aiquota-plugin-claude` must be in the same directory or on your PATH.

aiquota.intervalSeconds.description: Seconds between measurements (at least 30: the usage endpoint is not to be hammered).

aiquota.cooldownSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between two measurements, clicks and refresh commands included.

aiquota.timeoutSeconds.description: A measurement still running after this long is killed and shown as unknown.

aiquota.bands.description: Number of equal colour bands per window (8 = steps of 12.5 %: light green to dark red).

aiquota.statusbar.alignment.description: Which side of the status bar the items are on. auto follows what aiquota describes (right).

aiquota.statusbar.priority.description: Base priority of the group (higher is further left within a side). Each item adds the offset aiquota gives it (0 to just under -1), so they stay contiguous unless another extension picks a priority inside that range.

aiquota.warnPercent.description: Worst window percentage from which the item turns to the warning colour.

aiquota.criticalPercent.description: Worst window percentage from which the item turns to the error colour.
